description: Follow Maine, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump looms as tensions flare in final Maine Senate debate
changes.summary: The marathon of debates in the Maine Senate race has ended, but there is still one unanswered question: Just how large will President Donald Trump loom in November?

changes.title: 5 Takeaways From the Senate Debate in Maine
changes.summary: The race’s fourth and final debate centered around whether Senator Susan Collins, the Republican incumbent, was as independent as she claimed to be from President Trump.

changes.title: Democrats Worry About Tight Midterm Races in Maine, Michigan and Minnesota
changes.summary: Despite hopes for a blue wave, Democratic candidates in Minnesota, Maine and Michigan are facing local political headwinds and have struggled to open up clear daylight in the polls.

changes.title: Soaring heating oil prices put struggling Maine families in a bind
changes.summary: The price of heating oil in Maine has soared from $3.34 per gallon one year ago to $5.97 today, a jump of roughly 79%.

changes.title: Maine couple forced to choose food or heat as oil prices skyrocket
changes.summary: Along with diesel and gas, the price of heating oil is up, and no state depends on it more than Maine. Meg Oliver spoke with residents there, now forced to make some tough decisions.

changes.title: 5 Takeaways From a Heated and Personal Maine Senate Debate
changes.summary: Senator Susan Collins, a Republican, and her Democratic challenger, Troy Jackson, disagreed over the war in Iran and President Trump in the third of four debates in a key race.

changes.title: Iran war and affordability take center stage in Senate debates
changes.summary: The economic backdrop of the 2026 midterms is causing political heartburn for many Republicans. CBS News congressional correspondent Caitlin Huey-Burns joins "The Takeout" with takeaways from the Maine, Georgia and Iowa Senate debates.

changes.title: An Ad Targeting Susan Collins’s Opponent, Troy Jackson, Airs in the Wrong Portland
changes.summary: An executive with the Republican super PAC that paid for the ad attacking Troy Jackson, the Democratic Senate candidate in Maine, blamed its vendor for running the ad in Oregon.
